company.name: SVAGS TECHNOLOGIES
company.mission: To build innovative software products that simplify everyday life and empower businesses worldwide through technology.
company.vision: To become a globally recognized technology company that creates multiple impactful products across diverse industries.
company.description: SVAGS TECHNOLOGIES is an Indian technology company on a mission to build world-class software products. We combine deep engineering expertise with a passion for design to create products that people love.

values.title: Innovation First
values.description: We challenge the status quo and embrace new ideas. Every product we build starts with asking 'what if we could do this better?'

values.title: Security by Design
values.description: Security is not an afterthought. We architect every system with security at its core, protecting our users and their data.

values.title: Engineering Excellence
values.description: We hold ourselves to the highest engineering standards. Clean code, robust architecture, and continuous improvement define us.

values.title: Built to Scale
values.description: We design for tomorrow, not just today. Our systems are architected to handle millions of users without breaking a sweat.

values.title: Customer First
values.description: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We listen, learn, and build products that genuinely solve real problems.

milestones.title: Company Incorporated
milestones.description: SVAGS TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED was incorporated in India on June 16, 2026 with a vision to build world-class software products.

milestones.title: SVAGS Launched
milestones.description: Our first product, SVAGS — a Smart Car Service Platform — launched on August 17, 2026 as a website and native Android and iOS app, connecting car owners with trusted service centers.
